notes:
{玉|たま} refers to round objects, gems, or balls. The kanji can also be read as ぎょく in some compounds.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {目玉|めだま}: eyeball
- {玉子|たまご}: egg (also written {卵|たまご})
- {玉ねぎ|たまねぎ}: onion
- {水玉|みずたま}: polka dots, water droplet
- {玉入|たまい}れ: ball-toss game
- {百円玉|ひゃくえんだま}: 100-yen coin

EXPRESSIONS:
- {玉|たま}に{瑕|きず}: a fly in the ointment (lit. a flaw in a gem)
- {玉|たま}のような{肌|はだ}: flawless skin (lit. skin like a gem)

READINGS:
- たま: native Japanese reading (round object, ball)
- ぎょく: Sino-Japanese reading in {玉座|ぎょくざ} (throne), {宝玉|ほうぎょく} (jewel)

NOTE:
Can refer to bullets ({鉄砲玉|てっぽうだま}) in informal speech.
